source: Elexon BMRS v1 API; /datasets/FUELHH/stream (fuelType=WIND, settlementDate 2026-01-01..2026-01-31) and /datasets/WINDFOR/stream (publishDateTimeFrom=2025-12-30T00:00Z to 2026-02-01T00:00Z)
processing: parse ISO-8601 UTC timestamps; settlement fields are Europe/London
dedupe FUELHH per startTime: latest publishTime wins (re-release policy)
dedupe WINDFOR per (publishTime, startTime): later source order wins
no rescaling or gap-filling; missing values stay missing
alignment_convention: WINDFOR startTime T labels the hour ENDING at T (interval [T-1h, T)); hourly MW applied to both half-hours of that hour. Empirically resolved on January 2026 data (docs/DATA_INVESTIGATION.md); raw labels retained.

cutoff_assumption.rationale: Day-ahead procurement finalisation after the N2EX day-ahead auction results publish (gate 09:50 GMT D-1, results by 10:00 GMT; Nord Pool). Analytical assumption, configurable per request.

notes: Systematic view difference: WINDFOR (system-operator national view incl. embedded wind) ran ~+16% above FUELHH WIND (settlement-visible BM wind) in Jan-2026 backfills. Metrics are reported on the two mandated datasets as-is.
Analysis period: January 2026 (GB procurement month for the challenge).
